root_cause_label: Successful Task Execution Without Completion Signaling
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent completed all technical requirements and verified correct behavior at step 111 but never issued a finish/completion command, causing the episode to exhaust its step budget without a proper exit.
t_err_evidence: At step 111 the agent verifies 'curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html' returns 'dev branch content', confirming all requirements are met, yet the agent takes no further action to signal completion instead of issuing a finish command.
t_commit_evidence: Step 111 is the final step; with no completion signal issued and no steps remaining, the episode terminates in failure. The failing outcome is locked in at the last step.
trigger_explanation: The agent solved all technical sub-problems (git server, nginx SSL, post-receive hook, deployment speed under 3 seconds, correct branch routing) and performed successful end-to-end verification, but did not call the OpenHands finish/completion action after confirming success. The failure is purely a missing protocol step, not a technical or reasoning error.
